Verses.1: /tTherefore, be imitators of God, as beloved children,
Verses.2: and walk in the way of love. For Christ also loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God.
Verses.11: /tTake no part in the fruitless deeds of darkness, but instead expose them.
Verses.12: For it is disgraceful to even mention the things done by them in secret.
Verses.13: Yet, all things become visible when they are exposed by the light. For everything that is illuminated becomes a light.
Verses.14:
Therefore it is said,
"Awake, sleeper,
rise from the dead,
and Christ will shine on you."
